scope: Actual static task construction, CMSIS mutex/semaphore wrappers, kernel recursive ownership, inherited/restored priorities, task/ISR semaphore operations, queues/critical/heap/list providers and full reclamation
limitations: Current task is selected by controlled pointer writes; inheritance is invoked explicitly without blocking/context transfer. Task entry pointers remain unexecuted, and stack frames are outside this comparison. IRQ/mask/MMIO values are fixtures. Only authenticated heap caller LR is normalized. No blocking resumption, hardware concurrency or whole-image identity proof.
